async function getGundamData() {  
  try {  
    const response \= await fetch('https://githubusercontent.com');  
    const data \= await response.json();  
      
    // Example: If your JSON has an image URL, display it  
    document.getElementById('my-image').src \= data.gundams\[0\].url;  
      
  } catch (error) {  
    console.log("Fetch failed:", error);  
  }  
}

getGundamData();
